notes: First validation round caught two deterministic failures rooted in the new ATL Streak feature: BattleInventoryAudit failed because AwardEnemyKill overwrote the shotgun ZOMBIE DOWN notice with the STREAK xN label on every kill, and BattleStreakAudit failed its exact-health guard because passive regen healed the rider during the 5.5s reset wait. Commit fa7c680 fixed both (x1/x2 kills keep the weapon kill label and the streak banner takes over at x3; the streak audit measures the x1 heal guard at kill time instead of after passive regen), and both audits were re-verified green on the rebuilt package (BattleInventoryAudit passed:true phase:20 crates:20; BattleStreakAudit passed:true streak:1 best:3 kills:4 health:87). The one remaining red was BattleDroneAudit, which missed its 35m pistol shot in the first sweep (off_target_cm ~2400) and failed its retry with the same verdict. That flake was root-caused and fixed in three commits: 91d3aed (arcade aim-assist was redirecting the pistol shot onto stray hostile pawns near the firing lane, so the audit now freezes enemy spawns and clears hostiles at start like the melee audit), 7782bc6 (the distant target drone was mid-dive under sweep load, so its tick is now disabled after spawn and the marksmanship stage tests a hovering target), and eb40d96 (the start clear now covers every aim-assist lock candidate: zombies, police, gunmen, knife attackers, and PiedmontThreat). The package was rebuilt from eb40d96 and BattleDroneAudit ran standalone 8 times, 8/8 green including the cold first launch. This final full sweep of 31 entries (work\sweep-151-final2-20260919-113257.log): 30 passed first-pass, including BattleDroneAudit, BattleInventoryAudit, and BattleStreakAudit; BattleDuckAudit failed once (ducks=8, over_water=2, below the three-on-open-water guard) and passed its single allowed retry (over_water=4, notice=DUCK!) on the same binary, so the sweep is green with one fail-then-pass flake and zero failures.
